listing.title: The Original Folk & Fairy Tales of the Brothers Grimm
listing.description: Discover the magic and mystery of the Brothers Grimm with this beautifully designed collection of their original folk and fairy tales. This edition features unique, vintage-inspired illustrations by Angela Dezső, capturing the enchanting and sometimes dark atmosphere of these timeless stories. Printed on a rich purple cover, the book invites readers into a world where imagination meets tradition. Perfect for lovers of classic literature, this collection brings the first edition tales to your bookshelf in a captivating and elegant package.
features: Original folk and fairy tales included

listing.title: Hansel y Gretel Illustrated Edition by King & Sendak
listing.description: Discover a beautifully illustrated version of the timeless tale Hansel y Gretel, adapted by Stephen King and Maurice Sendak. This special edition invites readers into a richly detailed world where every page bursts with intricate, hand-drawn illustrations in muted, earthy tones. The cover art depicts the siblings navigating a dense, mysterious forest, setting a mood of suspense and wonder. Perfect for collectors and fans of classic storytelling, this edition balances haunting visuals with captivating narrative, making it an ideal addition to any bookshelf. Enjoy a unique reading experience that blends artistry with literary charm.

listing.title: Hansel y Gretel Illustrated Edition by Agnese Baruzzi
listing.description: Discover the timeless tale of Hansel y Gretel in this beautifully illustrated edition by Agnese Baruzzi. Featuring a whimsical cover design that resembles a charming gingerbread house, this book invites readers into a magical world inspired by the classic Grimm Brothers' story. The delicate pastel colors and intricate paper-cut style illustrations bring warmth and nostalgia, perfect for both young readers and collectors. Ideal for storytime, this edition offers a fresh, artistic interpretation that captures the imagination while honoring the beloved fairy tale.
